₹1 crore for your IoT startup. Applications close this Sunday.

IIT Bombay's IoT Technology Innovation Hub (TIH IIT Bombay) has opened Aarohan 7.0, its seed support programme. It invests up to ₹1 crore, as equity or CCPS, in startups whose IoT or AI-powered autonomous products are already working in the real world.

This edition focuses on four areas: autonomous systems for factories, warehouses and logistics; field and inspection systems for farms and infrastructure; assistive systems for hospitals; and tech for dairy and livestock.

Who can apply: DPIIT-recognised startups (or those eligible for it), with at least 51% Indian promoter shareholding and a product at TRL 6 or above. Idea-stage teams won't qualify.

One thing founders miss: this is an investment, not a grant. Read the equity terms before applying, and keep your cap table, financials and TIH's budget template ready.

Last date: 22 November 2026.
